title: Quenched Velvety Brazilian Flat Rice Noodles Tagine
description: A monsoon-inspired Brazilian dish featuring flat rice noodles in a rich and bitter tagine sauce, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a rainy day.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced bitter melon and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and coconut milk, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the flat rice noodles to the tagine pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season the dish with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the quenched velvety brazilian flat rice noodles tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
